logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Named exclusions in notes: 'Family balancing is not eligible for coverage.'; six techniques 'considered experimental or investigational'.
logic.initial_vs_repeat: Cycle limit with exception: 'Four (4) cycles for any Assisted Reproductive Technologies (ARTs): - IVF, ZIFT, GIFT, AI ... NOTE: If medical circumstances warrant consideration of more than four (4) cycles, additional cycles will be reviewed for medical appropriateness (e.g., a new cause of infertility is discovered and treated during covered therapy)'.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: If the benefit for coverage for infertility treatment is available and there is documentation of infertility for at least one year's duration, the following indications meet the definition of medical necessity:
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Two preconditions joined by 'and' gate every following bullet; the benefit condition is a contract fact, not a chart fact.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Four (4) cycles for any Assisted Reproductive Technologies (ARTs): - IVF, ZIFT, GIFT, AI
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: AI is called an ART here but is a separate bullet above; the four-cycle count is shared across techniques or per technique?

and_or_ambiguity.quote: For AI, during one ovulatory cycle, sperm may be inseminated twice ... This is considered to be two attempts during one cycle
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Defines a counting rule inside a NOTE: a cycle counts as one even with two attempts, but 'two attempts' language conflicts.

definitions_that_change_meaning.definition_quote: One "cycle" of IVF includes using medicines to stimulate the ovaries to ovulate, "harvesting" the eggs with an instrument, attempting to fertilize the eggs with sperm in the lab, and placing any embryos into the uterus.

vague_terms.problem: No required tests or age-adjusted time frame.

extraction_hazards: Bullet text uses hyphen/en-dash lists inside bullets ('- IVF, ZIFT, GIFT, AI').
Coding header sentence says codes are 'not all inclusive'.
The Definitions section is ~45 entries and OTHER lists synonyms of procedure names; neither is criteria.
Revision date 10/01/26 is a quarterly code update, later than the 05/28/26 review and committee date, so 'Revised' is not always a criteria change.
interesting_structures: Benefit-conditional coverage: the guideline's rules apply only 'if the benefit ... is available'.
Technique-by-technique investigational paragraphs (6 of them), each repeating 'The evidence is insufficient to determine ...'.

fit_to_tree.why: The tree itself is small (duration >= 1 year, technique listed, cycles <= 4), but the root condition is a contract benefit outside the chart, cycle counts need claims history, and 'additional cycles reviewed' is judgment.
